Appearance
From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from French évoluer, from Latin ēvolvere. Doublet of evolver.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /e.vo.luˈi(ʁ)/ [e.vo.lʊˈi(h)], (faster pronunciation) /e.voˈlwi(ʁ)/ [e.voˈlwi(h)]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /e.vo.luˈi(ʁ)/ [e.vo.lʊˈi(h)], (faster pronunciation) /e.voˈlwi(ʁ)/ [e.voˈlwi(h)]
    • (São Paulo) IPA(key): /e.vo.luˈi(ɾ)/ [e.vo.lʊˈi(ɾ)], (faster pronunciation) /e.voˈlwi(ɾ)/
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /e.vo.luˈi(ʁ)/ [e.vo.lʊˈi(χ)], (faster pronunciation) /e.voˈlwi(ʁ)/ [e.voˈlwi(χ)]
    • (Caipira) IPA(key): /e.vo.luˈi(ɻ)/ [e.vo.lʊˈi(ɻ)], (faster pronunciation) /e.voˈlwi(ɻ)/
 
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /i.vuˈlwiɾ/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /i.vuˈlwiɾ/
    • (Northern Portugal) IPA(key): /i.buˈlwiɾ/ [i.βuˈlwiɾ]
    • (Southern Portugal) IPA(key): /i.vuˈlwi.ɾi/

Verb

[edit]

evoluir (first-person singular present evoluo, first-person singular preterite evoluí, past participle evoluído)

  1. to evolve
